## People
- Sam reviews the octos PRs.

body.page:
# steer-queue

Redelivers queued steering messages after a reconnect.

## Facts
- Drains a snapshot first so the order stays stable.
- Backoff starts at 250 ms and resets after a successful send.

## Related
